user.title: Můj ČEZ
user.description: Sign in with your muj.cez.cz account. Installation guide (Czech): [guide]({docs_url}).

account.title: Customer account
account.description: This ČEZ ID has several customer accounts (e.g. shared access of another person). Choose the account to load. Add another account as another instance of the integration with the same login.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Update schedule, reference sensors and dashboard. Grid import/export sensors are prefilled from the Energy dashboard, the spot price sensor from cz_energy_spot_prices (when installed); everything can be changed. All options explained (Czech): [guide]({docs_url}).

data_description.update_period: Weekly updates run on Mondays, monthly on the 1st day of the month.
data_description.update_time: Local time of the update. Data is also loaded when Home Assistant starts.
data_description.reference_sensor: Energy sensor measuring grid import (kWh, with long-term statistics). Used to compare HA measurement with the portal.
data_description.reference_export_sensor: Energy sensor of grid export (kWh, with long-term statistics). Compared with the export measured by the ČEZ smart meter.
data_description.spot_price_sensor: Optional. Current spot price sensor (CZK/kWh or CZK/MWh, with long-term statistics), e.g. from cz_energy_spot_prices. Fills prices for valuing the export where the ČEZ portal has none (since October 2025).
data_description.dashboard: Where to add the ČEZ view with charts (generated from the entities of this HA, with or without PV).
data_description.install_cards: Installs cards missing for the dashboard via Marketplace / HACS (when present), otherwise downloads the latest release from GitHub.
data_description.hdo: Loads the low/high tariff switching times (HDO) from the ČEZ Distribuce portal with the same credentials. Adds the current tariff, next switch and current price per kWh. Skipped silently when the portal has no HDO for the supply point.
data_description.price_breakdown: Downloads the settlements (CSV data file or PDF) and product price lists of the account and adds the "Cenový rozpad" dashboard tab: what each item costs per month, quarter and year (supplier part, distribution, taxes, PV payout). Off: nothing of this is downloaded and the tab is not created; turning it off deletes the downloaded invoices.

invoices.title: Invoice updates
invoices.description: How often to check new invoices and price lists of each supply point for the price breakdown. Prefilled by the length of its billing period; after a billing period ends the settlement is checked daily until it arrives (up to 30 days). A period you change is kept. Invoices of a point can be loaded at once with the button *Refresh invoices* in its *Prices* tab. More in the [guide]({docs_url}).

error.no_supply_points: The account has no supply points.

get_documents.name: Get documents
get_documents.description: Returns accounting documents (invoices, advances, payments, ...) of all contracts, newest first.

config_entry_id.name: Account
config_entry_id.description: Můj ČEZ account. Optional when only one account is configured.

date_from.name: From
date_from.description: Only documents with due/issue date on or after this date.

date_to.name: To
date_to.description: Only documents with due/issue date on or before this date.

document_type.name: Document type
document_type.description: Substring of the document type, e.g. Faktura, Záloha, Platba.

contract.name: Contract
contract.description: Contract number or part of the contract name.

unpaid_only.name: Unpaid only
unpaid_only.description: Only documents with a remaining balance.

update_dashboard.name: Update dashboard
update_dashboard.description: Regenerates the ČEZ view in the selected dashboard from the current entities.

entry_not_loaded.message: The Můj ČEZ account is not loaded.

entry_required.message: More accounts are configured, select one.

confirm.title: Install cards
confirm.description: The ČEZ view needs these cards: {cards}. The integration installs them via Marketplace / HACS, otherwise from GitHub. Reload the browser page afterwards.

dashboard_failed.title: Můj ČEZ dashboard could not be written
dashboard_failed.description: Error: {error}. Select another dashboard in the integration options.
